pages.text: A watermelon sat in the yard's water tub. The water was very cold. Grandma cut the melon and put it in a bowl.
"I want the coldest pieces." Yuki looked into the bowl.
Yuki picked up a big piece. Their hand felt cool. "Wow, it's cold!"
Yuki picked up another big piece with the other hand. "This one's mine, too." With two hands, there was room for no more.
Yuki sat on the porch and crunched one piece, resting the other on their knees. In the shade, Momo panted with tongue out.
Sunshine reached the porch. The watermelon on Yuki's knees grew limp.
Yuki bit into it. It was lukewarm. "It doesn't taste good at all."
Grandma put the remaining watermelon back in the tub. The water splashed.
Yuki took out just one piece. The others stayed in the water. "I'll finish this, then take another."
After eating one piece, Yuki took the next from the tub. "It's still cold!"
